summary.text: Bryce Edgmon has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 37 since 2007 and was Speaker of the House from 2017 to 2020 and again from 2025.

paragraphs.text: Edgmon's legislative biography says Edgmon was born in Dillingham on May 3, 1961, and has lived there since, and lists a B.B.A. from the University of Alaska Anchorage.
It lists Edgmon as a former chief operating officer of the Bristol Bay Economic Development Corporation and board chairman of Choggiung Ltd.
